purpose: Draws the read-only card of a person from the holder's circles who has no record, and offers to make the holder's own card of them.
namedChanges: The imports are the peers': `createOnlineCardController` and `cardName` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-online-card`; `resolvePersonCard` from `person-connections`; `PartialCreateError` from `pick-or-create`; `bareForm` from `vocabulary-source`; the type `OneCardGroup` from `one-card-merge`; `AddYourOwnButton` from `add-your-own`; `StakeholderContactHeader` from `stakeholder-contact-header`; `OneCardBody`, `OneCardOwnGroups`, `useOnlineCardState`, `useOnlineCardLabelFor` from `one-card`; `ownVaultIdOf` from `plan-self-source`; `canonicaliserFor`, `personCardPlatform`, `sessionConnections`, `onlineCardDeps`, `heldVaultsOwnFirst`, `linkedRecordsOf` from `stakeholder-list-doors`; `newestLinkedId`, `screenRecordLinkedTo`, `forgetLinkedFinds`, `isDeletedLinkedRecord` from `stakeholder-list-state`; `stakeholderCardState`, `fieldOfTerm`, `termName` from `stakeholder-card-model`; `stakeholderCardVocabularyQuery` from `stakeholder-card-vocabulary`; `afterRecordPerson`, `pickerReadingQuery`, `recordableKinds`, `recordPerson` from `person-create`; `deleteRecord` from `lws-records`; `idFromEntityUri`, `idFromUri` from `lws-vault-sets`. In the source these are `gilb-stakeholders`, `gilb-stakeholders-ui`, `../ShellContext`, `./StakeholderContactHeader`, `./OneCardBody`, `../../lib/...` and `./onlineStakeholders`.
`ONLINE_ROW_TYPE` (GilbApp `src/components/records/onlineStakeholders.ts:257`, a fragment) is a private constant of the file, the same literal `"t:Person"`, declared after `PERSON`.

Six host members are added (the interface `OnlineStakeholderCardHost`, its context and `useOnlineStakeholderCardHost()`, which throws an error naming the missing provider): the hook `useShell`, the callback `refreshOnlineStakeholders`, `photoReadKeysSync`, and the three hosts the peers take as an argument: `doors` (`StakeholderListDoorsHost`), `person` (`PersonCreateHost`) and `vocabulary` (`CardVocabularyHost`). The component begins with `const host = useOnlineStakeholderCardHost();` (a context read before the source's first statement). `useShell()` is `host.useShell()`, `refreshOnlineStakeholders()` is `host.refreshOnlineStakeholders()` (three calls), `photoReadKeysSync()` is `host.photoReadKeysSync()`, `stakeholderCardVocabularyQuery()` is `stakeholderCardVocabularyQuery(host.vocabulary)`, `linkedRecordsOf(holder!, ...)` is `linkedRecordsOf(host.doors, holder!, ...)`, `recordPerson(deps, input)` is `recordPerson(host.person, deps, input)` and `afterRecordPerson(qc, made)` is `afterRecordPerson(host.person, qc, made)` (two calls). Same place, same other arguments.
Comments made generic (cycle, ticket and agent tags and names removed); no code change.
Nothing else changed: the hook order, the person-card query options and key, the exported messages and the markup are the source's.
